description: A full due-diligence memo on any token in one run. Structured like exchange listing reviews (Coinbase, Kraken) and lending-risk onboarding (Aave, Gauntlet, LlamaRisk): liquidity and markets, supply and holder concentration, contract and admin powers, onchain activity, derivatives, development and community, and CoinGraph's own track record on the token. Each section gets a grade with its evidence, plus red flags, strengths and an overall grade. Returns one of: A / B / C / D / F, with a plain summary, structured result, sourced reasons and a proof id. Price: 10 tADA on testnet (pro).

token.description: Token: CoinGecko id (chainlink), symbol (LINK) or contract address
